items.title: Peru joins US-led Shield of the Americas counter-cartel alliance
items.title_zh: 秘鲁加入美主导“美洲之盾”反卡特尔安全联盟
items.summary_zh: 秘鲁总统藤森惠子在利马会见美国务卿鲁比奥后宣布加入“美洲之盾”（Shield of the Americas / ACCC），强调国会授权外国驻军的主权红线不变。联盟以情报共享与更强硬军事协作打击跨国犯罪；哥伦比亚亦于鲁比奥南美行程中加入。华盛顿同步押注秘鲁铜矿与海军基地合作，中方使馆反驳“后院”叙事。

quotes.author: Marco Rubio
quotes.en: It is a shield against these transnational criminal groups that, in many cases, have more money and better military equipment than the state.
quotes.zh: 这是对抗跨国犯罪集团的盾牌——它们往往比国家更有钱、装备更好。

items.title: Reverse engineering my e-scooter and rewriting the firmware in Rust
items.title_zh: 逆向电动滑板车并用Rust重写固件
items.summary_zh: 作者拆解消费级电动滑板车控制链路，用Rust重写固件以拿回本地控制权。HN约276赞，讨论电控安全、UI框架选择与“右到维修”。与车联网遥测争议同周，追问谁拥有运动器械上的计算。

quotes.author: abound
quotes.en: This is an unbelievably impressive project and a killer write up, very satisfying. I wonder if the author looked into using Slint [1] for the UI, given the codegen bloat issues they had with buoyant (which also looks very cool). I haven't used either, but I've done a few projects with Embassy and am always looking for an excuse to try embedded GUI tools [1] https://slint.rs/
quotes.zh: 这个项目与写得令人难以置信地漂亮，读起来很过瘾。好奇作者有没有考虑用Slint做UI——他们提到buoyant代码生成膨胀，Slint在嵌入式上可能更合适。

quotes.author: trevithick
quotes.en: Reverse engineering like this is black magic to me. The writeup is good. It's detailed and I could follow along with what the author was doing even though I'm too stupid to ever attempt something like this. Nice job author. I liked bullet 2 in the Introduction.
quotes.zh: 对我来说这种逆向像黑魔法。写得细致，即便我绝不可能亲手做，也能跟上作者步骤。干得漂亮。我尤其喜欢引言里的第二点。

items.title: Google to invest €13bn in Finnish AI infrastructure, signs nuclear PPA
items.title_zh: 谷歌芬兰砸下130亿欧元AI基建，签洛维萨核电购电长约
items.summary_zh: 谷歌宣布未来两年在芬兰投入至少130亿欧元（约151亿美元）AI基础设施，称系其欧洲单笔最大投资：新建凯亚尼、穆霍斯、瓦拉数据中心并扩建哈米纳。Fortum同步签22年购电协议，谷歌最高可购洛维萨核电站约50%出力，并探讨新核电与储能。Ruth Porat称此为美国境外首笔核电交易，口号是“BYOP：自带电力”。

quotes.author: Ruth Porat / Google
quotes.en: We call this BYOP, bring your own power.

items.title: Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to 'distill' frontier models, too
items.title_zh: Garry Tan吁美国开源权重实验室“蒸馏”前沿模型并开源
items.summary_zh: Y Combinator的Garry Tan主张美国开源权重实验室应合法蒸馏前沿闭源模型并公开，以匹配开源阵营速度。HN约238赞，争议在蒸馏是加速器还是系统性侵权。

quotes.author: kelnos
quotes.en: I agree. The frontier models are based on training data from tons of copyrighted work. Some of that work was obtained illegally, even. They could not exist without strip-mining the commons. The labs have no moral or ethical ownership to the end result, and others should feel free to treat any company-imposed restrictions on their use as invalid. I don't expect Tan's position to be based on any kind of real moral high ground, but his conclusion is correct. I love the "illicit distillation…
quotes.zh: 同意。前沿模型建立在海量版权作品的训练数据上，其中一些甚至是非法获得的。没有对公地的掠夺它们就不存在。实验室对最终产物没有道德所有权，其他人应可自由蒸馏。

quotes.author: darepublic
quotes.en: I cannot feel anything but schadenfreude regarding anthropic having its IP stolen from it. Bravo Chinese labs, bravo
quotes.zh: 对Anthropic知识产权被偷这件事我只有幸灾乐祸。干得好，中国实验室，干得好。

items.title: Finland opposition warns Google AI deal could strain power supply
items.title_zh: 芬兰反对党警告：谷歌AI大单或挤兑电力与电价
items.summary_zh: 谷歌投资公布次日，芬兰中间党等反对力量呼吁建立全国性数据中心许可制度，以防电力短缺与电价飙升。安全情报机构SUPO亦提示外资数据中心的安全风险。政府强调就业与GDP拉动，反对派则追问：核电长约锁定后，居民与中小企业是否成“挤出”对象。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Finland should introduce a national permitting system for data centres to prevent the risk of power shortages and soaring energy prices, opposition parties said.
quotes.zh: 反对党表示，芬兰应建立全国性数据中心许可制度，以防电力短缺与能源价格飙升。

items.title: Data collected by cars and sold to third parties
items.title_zh: 汽车收集的数据正被卖给第三方
items.summary_zh: 讨论汇总车企遥测出售给保险、营销与数据经纪商的路径。HN约174赞，评论区分“车的事实”与“驾驶员的事实”，并讲述关停采集后仍被追踪的经历。

quotes.author: bitparadox
quotes.en: I posted a flavor of this comment on an article a few months ago, but it's relevant here: I have a seven year old Volkswagen, not financed. I'm security conscious and made sure to disable all the data collection I could find in the companion app before removing my account, turn off remote access services, dig through the infotainment to turn off what I could, etc. Last year I requested a Carfax on it, and one of the fields in the request was current mileage. I entered an estimate like 75000…
quotes.zh: 我有一辆七年车龄、已结清的大众。我很在意安全，在注销账号前关掉了伴侣App里能找到的所有数据采集，结果仍发现追踪并未真正停止——关闭开关不等于管道拆除。

quotes.author: samsullivan
quotes.en: Two different things are getting called "car data" here. Facts about the car: VIN, spec, recall status, odometer. Attested by someone other than the owner. Outlives every owner and the owner is the last to have it, if at all. Facts about the driver: speed, location, timestamp. Thats what GM sold, the fix is to not collect it but OEMs seem to take 'anonymization' approach. The DRIVER act treats both as the same which is why it fails to fix anything. The second needs a ban. The first needs the…
quotes.zh: 这里有两件不同的东西都被叫作“车数据”。关于车的事实：VIN、配置、召回、里程——由非车主证明，寿命长过每位车主。关于驾驶员的事实：速度、位置、时间戳——那才是该默认禁止出售的部分。

items.title: Hamburg DPA: Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses expose bystanders without consent
items.title_zh: 汉堡数据监管：雷朋Meta智能眼镜未经同意暴露路人
items.summary_zh: 汉堡数据保护专员9月10日发布约53页终报：经硬件拆解、App流量与本地数据审计，认定Ray-Ban Meta AI眼镜主要风险在被拍摄的路人而非佩戴者；在GDPR下，佩戴者与Meta可能对路人数据处理承担共同责任。报告关注默认训练数据与路人退出困难，为欧盟智能眼镜执法提供技术样板。

quotes.author: Hamburg Commissioner for Data Protection
quotes.en: Ray-Ban Meta AI Glasses create data protection problems for the people captured by the device's camera and microphones, not primarily for the wearers themselves.
quotes.zh: 雷朋Meta AI眼镜造成的数据保护问题，主要落在被镜头与麦克风捕获的路人身上，而非首先落在佩戴者。

items.title: David Sacks: OpenAI and Anthropic Don't Need Regulations to Pace Frontier Models
items.title_zh: David Sacks：OpenAI与Anthropic不需要靠监管来“放缓”前沿
items.summary_zh: 特朗普阵营AI事务官David Sacks反对以监管束缚OpenAI/Anthropic。HN约161赞，评论区指其真实意图是抬高合规门槛形成护城河，甚至有人斥为“勒索国家”。

quotes.author: throwaway63467
quotes.en: I guess what they really want is to limit sale of AI models to compliant vendors and then raise the bar to compliance just high enough so they can pass it but smaller labs can’t. There’s no moat, it’s an efficient market that drives margins to zero right now, of course they don’t want that, collusion of the big vendors is the next logical step.
quotes.zh: 我猜他们真正想要的是：只允许合规供应商卖模型，再把合规门槛抬到刚好自己过得去、小实验室过不去。现在没有护城河，高效市场把利润打成零，他们当然“不需要监管来放缓”。

quotes.author: deagle50
quotes.en: I'll go a step further, they aren't just pretending, they are blackmailing the country. The sane response would be "we don't negotiate with terrorists, and you will face criminal and financial penalties for damages caused."
quotes.zh: 我再往前走一步：他们不只是装样子，而是在勒索国家。理智回应应是“不与恐怖分子谈判，你们将对造成的损害承担刑事与财务责任”。

items.title: EU doubles down on AI Act after Anthropic exit sparks extinction scare
items.title_zh: Anthropic离职引爆灭绝恐慌后，欧盟加码押注AI法案执法
items.summary_zh: 一名Anthropic员工离职并警告业者“真心相信模型可能在十年末杀死所有人”后，硅谷恐慌升温；布鲁塞尔则强调AI法案已覆盖系统风险与失控/未对齐义务。欧委会发言人称框架已在；欧洲议会拟于9月30日例行执法对谈中讨论该警告。议员呼吁对系统风险模型“全面执法”。

quotes.author: Thomas Regnier / European Commission
quotes.en: The EU already has a legal framework to regulate and mitigate the risk posed by advanced models.
quotes.zh: 欧盟已有法律框架，用以规制并缓释先进模型带来的风险。

items.title: Why is the x86 undefined instruction called ud2? Why 2?
items.title_zh: x86的未定义指令为何叫ud2？为什么是2？
items.summary_zh: 短文追溯x86 `ud2` 助记符与永久无效指令如何成为内核BUG捕获工具。HN约146赞，评论补完UD0/UD1/UD2/UDB谱系与手册记载。

quotes.author: hacker_homie
quotes.en: Thus finally the 0F FF believers were rewarded by being give the honor of op code UD0 making it the one and true original invalid opcode permanently disgracing the 0F B9 adherents with the shame of UD1.
quotes.zh: 于是信仰0F FF的人终于得到褒奖，获封操作码UD0，成为真正原始的永久非法指令；0F B9信徒则蒙羞，只配叫UD1。

quotes.author: 349ru3h4f03
quotes.en: Nowadays UD0 UD1 UD2 are in the SDM and APM. We also got UDB (D6), the one-byte variant that arrived with x86-64 for 64-bit mode. And we have always had UDW (FF FF), aka group #5 (1st FF) with a modrm byte of mod=11b r/m=111b (/7) reg=111b (2nd FF) -- that one matters for memory with all bits set to 1, or for buses terminated to all 1 when no device claims an access.
quotes.zh: 如今UD0/UD1/UD2都进了SDM与APM。我们还有随x86-64到来的单字节UDB（D6），以及一直存在的UDW（FF FF）——对内存操作数场景很关键。
